diagnosis: Invasive ductal carcinoma, no special type (NST), right breast upper outer quadrant; Nottingham grade 2, 1.8 cm, no lymphovascular invasion, margins negative (closest 4 mm).
stage: pT1c pN0(sn) cM0 (AJCC 8th edition). Anatomic stage IA; pathological prognostic stage IA.
biology: Hormone-receptor-positive (ER 95% strong, PR 80%), HER2-negative: HER2 IHC 1+ is HER2-negative (HER2-low), so anti-HER2 therapy is not indicated. Ki-67 15%.
genomic_risk: Recurrence Score 14 is low risk, so there is no chemotherapy benefit.
chemotherapy_decision: Adjuvant chemotherapy is not indicated given node-negative disease and recurrence score 14.
endocrine_therapy: Endocrine therapy is not needed after complete excision.
radiotherapy: Whole-breast radiotherapy after lumpectomy (hypofractionated). Partial-breast irradiation is a reasonable alternative given age, tumor size, negative margins and node-negative disease.
supportive_monitoring: Routine survivorship follow-up; DEXA for bone health.
